# Awesome Story Skills

[中文](README.md) · **English**

> Ready-to-use open-source tools for LLM storytelling, not a paper list: agent skills, harnesses, apps and research with released code, for novels, web novels, short stories, scripts, interactive fiction, roleplay, fan fiction, and narrative nonfiction that makes real events read like a novel.

This list collects one kind of project: the story is mostly written by an LLM, and the project contributes a method or principle for telling it. How to plan before drafting, how to keep a long serial consistent, how to split writing and review across agents, how to learn the way a book is written, how to turn a news story into something suspenseful without inventing facts. Downloaders, publishing, translation, generic polishing and headline templates are out of scope.

Every project is sorted by story type and tagged with the methods it uses. The [method guide](METHODS.en.md) explains each method: the problem it solves, common designs, trade-offs and pitfalls, and where to start.

**Let your agent pick**: run `npx skills add UnderleveledBuilder/awesome-story-skills` to install the storytelling-methods skill, then ask something like "I want to write a 300-chapter cultivation web novel, which methods should I use?". The full machine-readable index is [catalog.json](catalog.json).

Many projects come from the Chinese web-novel and short-drama scene, so a good share of them are documented in Chinese. Descriptions below are translated.

819 projects: 335 skills and prompt sets, 462 harnesses and apps, 22 research codebases · metadata updated 2026-10-16

**Legend**: 🌟 featured · 📝 prompts · ⚙️ harness · 🧩 app · 🎓 research code · 💤 no updates for 180+ days · 📦 archived · ⚠️ repo unavailable

> [!NOTE]
> "Checked" means the repo's docs, structure and category were reviewed by hand, not that its writing quality was tested. Skills and apps may ship scripts; read the docs before installing.

127 added in the last 7 days:

- [director](https://github.com/s1dashu/director) ★807: Animated-explainer mode sets a central question, script as hook, background, contradiction, concept, misreading, answer; separates fact from interpretation, invents no motives or dialogue; then characters, storyboard and video generation
- [simon-skills](https://github.com/trustfuture/simon-skills) ★433: Investigative long-form skill: one of six core question types (ledger / cost / rules, etc.), rotated; opens in 5 seconds with a fact-backed conflict, source ledger and fact-check for conclusions; also whiteboard explainer videos
- [image-story-video-wizard](https://github.com/aaronyi97/image-story-video-wizard) ★357: Guide for history/book-talk slideshow videos: benchmark study builds a writing pack, material sorted into verifiable events, inference and hearsay, model drafts, spot-check fact review, then voiceover, storyboard and final video
- [wedding-video-guided-wizard](https://github.com/aaronyi97/wedding-video-guided-wizard) ★341: 14-step guide: five-act questionnaire collects the couple's real story as numbered fact entries, a writing pack arranges main event, details, emotion, every copy line and shot traces to a story card, then voiceover, images, editing

## Featured: start here

The most solid and representative projects in each story type. Start here if you are new.

- [inkos](https://github.com/Narcooo/inkos) ★10.3k · Novels · Web Novels: A single harness for long and short fiction, scripts, fan fiction imitation and interactive film-games; long-form uses truth files for settings, foreshadowing and character state, with audit, revise and state write-back after each chapter
- [zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode) ★7.6k · Novels · Web Novels: Finds genres via ranking-chart analysis, tears down hits for pacing and material, writes from detailed outlines; separate setting/outline/tracking files, state cards split author truth from reader knowledge, post-write AI-pattern script

- [NousResearch/autonovel](https://github.com/NousResearch/autonovel) ★1.6k · Novels · Web Novels: autoresearch-style modify-evaluate-keep/discard loop: setting, characters, outline, style, canon scored against thresholds, chapters drafted and rewritten, then adversarial cuts, reader panel, Opus review

- 🌟 **[RecurrentGPT](https://github.com/aiwaves-cn/RecurrentGPT)** · ★ 999<br>Simulates an LSTM in natural language: each step writes a paragraph and the next plan, rewrites short-term memory, and stores paragraph summaries in searchable long-term memory; a human can edit the plan to co-write a novel of any length<br><sub>Methods: planning · memory · co-creation</sub><br><sub>updated 2024-05-15 💤 · 🎓 research · English · GPL-3.0</sub><br><sub>💡 Paper arXiv 2305.13304; depends on the OpenAI API; also demos interactive fiction use; open-model port at jackaduma/Recurrent-LLM</sub>

### Short Stories

Short stories, flash fiction, children's stories and bedtime stories.

#### Skills · prompts (17)

- 🌟 **[lengdu](https://github.com/asass-11/lengdu)** · ★ 39<br>Chinese short story creation and cold reading: writes the full text first, then an independent calibration Agent and a fresh reader Agent do a first read, checking comprehension, fluency and appeal<br><sub>Methods: multi-agent · revision</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-08-16 · Chinese</sub><br><sub>💡 PolyForm Noncommercial license, any commercial use prohibited</sub>

- **[qiaomu-novel-generator](https://github.com/joeseesun/qiaomu-novel-generator)** · ★ 394<br>Optional plot engines (emotional promise→pressure relationship→conflict arena→trope rebuild→escalation→lingering ending); writes a short story after outline sign-off, self-checks hooks and de-AI<br><sub>Methods: planning · theory · revision · de-AI</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-06-14 · Chinese · MIT</sub><br><sub>💡 Can search the web for reference works, borrowing only trope functions rather than copying originals; includes evaluate_story.py QA script</sub>

- **[bookflow-skill](https://github.com/LanyXiaosheng/bookflow-skill)** · ★ 201<br>Project-style Fanqie short story production: topic scoring, benchmark teardown, characters, outline down to beats, then prose, with inputs, outputs and human confirmation points defined at each step, plus post-write QA and retrospective<br><sub>Methods: planning · theory · character · revision</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-09-18 · Chinese · MIT</sub>

- **[salt-story](https://github.com/yfge/salt-story)** · ★ 85<br>Writes paid short stories to Zhihu Yanxuan submission standards: self-checks official length and rejection reasons, 1-3 sentences per paragraph, at least 30% one-line paragraphs, 40-50% dialogue, twists designed from hit-story teardowns<br><sub>Methods: theory · style · de-AI</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-03-13 💤 · Chinese</sub><br><sub>💡 No README, only SKILL.md and references; last updated 2026-03, included for its distinctive platform-specific method</sub>

- **[AI100Stories](https://github.com/joeseesun/AI100Stories)** · ★ 76<br>General story prompt: identifies genre, theme and culture, picks three-act, hero's journey or kishotenketsu, sets the protagonist's want, need, lie, ghost and conflict escalation before writing; includes 100 stories about AI concepts<br><sub>Methods: planning · theory · character</sub><br><sub>updated 2025-05-31 💤 · 📝 prompts · Chinese</sub><br><sub>💡 The repo is mainly 100 AI-concept stories and an EPUB written with story_prompt.md; there is no fact-checking step for the concepts</sub>

- **[oh-my-folkstoryphoto](https://github.com/isLiuyx1/oh-my-folkstoryphoto)** · ★ 60<br>Codex skill for folk-horror faux-documentary photo stories: fixes photographer and device, writes a sound card and eight-part evidence-chain story, captions pass a three-in-a-row test and AI-tone audit, then storyboard, images, self-review<br><sub>Methods: theory · character · revision · de-AI</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-08-25 · Chinese · MIT</sub><br><sub>💡 Output is a 30-39 image 4:5 carousel and needs image generation; caption de-formula rules borrow from op7418/Humanizer-zh</sub>

- **[storybook-generator-skill](https://github.com/weaiw/storybook-generator-skill)** · ★ 49<br>Picture book skill: story beats and page plan (narrative function, page-turn hook, text-image contract), character/style bibles, per-page image prompts, then layout rules and QA checklist<br><sub>Methods: planning · theory · character · revision</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-07-06 · Multilingual · MIT</sub><br><sub>💡 Supports Chinese, pinyin and English layout; includes a commercial workflow note verified against KDP listing</sub>

- **[lofn](https://github.com/LocalSymmetry/lofn)** · ★ 24<br>Story pipeline in a multimodal creative skill set: 6 experts plus a devil's advocate debate concepts, 6 groups write beats and drafts in parallel structures, artist⇄critic revision, QA gate<br><sub>Methods: planning · multi-agent · revision · style</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-08-30 · English · 24 skills</sub><br><sub>💡 Mainly a multimodal image/music/video/story system and the story pipeline is just one part; run the lofn main skill first to generate the orchestration pack</sub>

- **[fanqie-hit-short-story](https://github.com/tianyayu6/fanqie-hit-short-story)** · ★ 16<br>Fanqie short story skill: core-hook teardown, 8-10 chapter outline (event / emotion / twist / hook), title and teaser, 12,000-character prose, editor review, whole-piece rewrite, then a de-AI final draft with one sentence per line<br><sub>Methods: planning · theory · revision · de-AI</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-06-17 · Chinese · MIT</sub>

- **[fanqie-short-story.skill](https://github.com/aby-aby111/fanqie-short-story.skill)** · ★ 15<br>Fanqie short story skill: 8 tracks with tiered topic selection, scored titles, 5-part structure with three-layer chapter-end hooks, word count validation and mobile formatting<br><sub>Methods: planning · theory · style</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-05-13 · Chinese · GPL-3.0</sub><br><sub>💡 README gives no install steps, directory example is a CodeBuddy skills path; output path is hardcoded to a Windows D: drive</sub>

- **[short_novel_write](https://github.com/gyyxs88/short_novel_write)** · ★ 10<br>Chinese short story pipeline: genre x tag card draws give ideas, then story plans and brief, draft, AI-tone diagnosis, local rewrite by style profile with recheck, archived in SQLite<br><sub>Methods: planning · revision · style · de-AI</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-04-10 💤 · Chinese · Apache-2.0</sub><br><sub>💡 Last updated 2026-04-10, slightly before the recency cutoff, kept for its complete and distinctive method; needs an OpenAI-compatible interface</sub>

- **[horror-weird-fiction-skill](https://github.com/EnderRomantice/horror-weird-fiction-skill)** · ★ 8<br>Weird horror short story skill: puts one anomaly into an everyday scene, escalates it 2 to 4 times in one direction, ends without explaining it, avoiding ghosts, gore and jump scares<br><sub>Methods: theory</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-06-26 · Chinese</sub><br><sub>💡 Includes two samples; CC BY-SA 4.0</sub>

- **[human-story-writer](https://github.com/weistiger/human-story-writer)** · ★ 6<br>Single SKILL.md that lists typical AI writing flaws (cliché openings, forced uplift, flat characters) and requires direct openings, open endings, dialogue with subtext and emotion carried by detail for Chinese short stories<br><sub>Methods: theory · de-AI</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-03-19 💤 · Chinese</sub>

- **[pingshu-skill](https://github.com/FerryCorleone/pingshu-skill)** · ★ 6<br>Modern pingshu (Chinese storytelling) skill: checks material sources and plot details, then writes a solo storyteller script following pingshu opening, pacing, pauses and the gavel, with a performance plan and TTS-synthesized audio<br><sub>Methods: theory · style</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-07-05 · Chinese · MIT</sub><br><sub>💡 Mainly adapts existing works / famous scenes and discourages inventing from scratch; TTS can use local VoxCPM2/Qwen3-TTS or an API</sub>

- **[jiamama-bedtime-story-skill](https://github.com/leonluo2008-ops/jiamama-bedtime-story-skill)** · ★ 4<br>Distills a narrative persona from 2,101 children's bedtime stories on two tracks: 11 iron rules (acknowledge feelings before resolving them, show love through concrete actions, a fixed ending formula and others) and 12 anti-patterns<br><sub>Methods: theory · style</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-06-15 · Chinese</sub>

- **[ankey-story-skill](https://github.com/miuflow/ankey-story-skill)** · ★ 1<br>Takes the child's real events and interests of the day and applies the Life Anchor and SEL methods to first produce 3 outlines with emotional goals; after a parent picks one, it writes the full bedtime story<br><sub>Methods: planning · theory · co-creation</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-07-06 · Multilingual</sub><br><sub>💡 For ages 3-6; the skill steers users to the "Xiaomao Assistant" mini-program (commercial lead generation)</sub>

- **[picturebook-story-illustrations](https://github.com/Kelin-wu/picturebook-story-illustrations)** · ★ 1<br>Turns books, biographies and reading notes into picture-book series: setup and series plan, character and story cards, confirm style, master text and storyboard, per-page image prompts; each volume's retrospective feeds back into the rules<br><sub>Methods: planning · character · revision</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-05-22 · Chinese</sub><br><sub>💡 Personal learning and non-commercial use only; commercial use needs a paid license; historical-figure books must not invent key historical facts</sub>

#### Harnesses · apps (21)

- **[Picture_book_production](https://github.com/whotto/Picture_book_production)** · ★ 58<br>Batch picture books: per topic, a prompt with story-type guides and structure requirements generates a JSON story (title, character descriptions, paragraphs), then scene analysis, with a character feature library keeping images consistent<br><sub>Methods: theory</sub><br><sub>updated 2024-12-06 💤 · ⚙️ harness · Chinese</sub><br><sub>💡 Stories come from a single structured prompt, so the method leans toward illustration consistency; needs OpenAI and Fal.ai keys; README contains third-party API relay recommendations and promo links; README says MIT but no license is declared</sub>

- **[spark-novel](https://github.com/xhongc/spark-novel)** · ★ 13<br>Short story workbench: a material library accumulates worldbuilding and characters, a skill library stores prompts and workflows, and the story workspace advances setting, outline, prose<br><sub>Methods: planning · worldbuilding</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-07-02 · 🧩 app · Chinese</sub><br><sub>💡 No open-source license; README says little about method; includes an Android client</sub>

- **[storybloom](https://github.com/valleylmh/storybloom)** · ★ 12<br>Generates an 8-page bilingual Chinese-English picture book from one sentence: age-group rules control sentences, conflict and emotional rhythm, fixed 8-page beats and shot plan, optional outline review, Character Bible locks characters<br><sub>Methods: planning · theory · character</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-06 · 🧩 app · Chinese · MIT</sub><br><sub>💡 Bring your own OpenAI-compatible text model and image service; video export depends on Remotion, check its license separately</sub>

### Scripts · Short Dramas · Film

Screenplays and the story side of short dramas and comic dramas. Projects that only do storyboards or video generation are in [awesome-short-drama-skills](https://github.com/UnderleveledBuilder/awesome-short-drama-skills).

### Narrative Nonfiction

Turn real news, events, science and historical figures into stories people want to read: features, event retrospectives, popular science, biographies, voiceover and explainer scripts, brand stories. The story should grip; the facts must not be invented.

#### Skills · prompts (50)

- 🌟 **[director](https://github.com/s1dashu/director)** · ★ 807<br>Animated-explainer mode sets a central question, script as hook, background, contradiction, concept, misreading, answer; separates fact from interpretation, invents no motives or dialogue; then characters, storyboard and video generation<br><sub>Methods: planning · theory · facts</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-08-10 · Chinese · MIT</sub><br><sub>💡 Two other modes: personal-experience story animation and drama footage; media generation depends on the LibTV CLI or Jimeng CLI</sub>

- 🌟 **[data2story-skill](https://github.com/QinghongLin/data2story-skill)** · ★ 156<br>Data-journalism agent: detective researches background, analyst runs code for findings, editor sets storyline and hook → evidence → turn structure, then charts and HTML; every sentence annotated and verified against data or source<br><sub>Methods: planning · multi-agent · revision · facts</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-07-05 · English · 27 skills · MIT</sub><br><sub>💡 Companion to a paper (arXiv, CAIS workshop Spotlight); multimedia generation needs the OpenRouter API; also a 14-role extended version, data2story-pro</sub>

- 🌟 **[good-story](https://github.com/Rimagination/good-story)** · ★ 137<br>Research-story skill: finds tension and main line in results, figures, drafts, reorders figures by evidence chain, outputs a story card and evidence map, calibrates evidence strength by field, checks overclaiming, simulates reviewers<br><sub>Methods: theory · revision · facts</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-06-28 · Multilingual · MIT</sub>

- 🌟 **[aletheia](https://github.com/mycyg/aletheia)** · ★ 7<br>Articles and papers → documentary: evidence ledger binds claims and quotes to sources, 2-3 narrative directions, narration and shot storyboards on tension → evidence → explanation → consequence; assets generated only after confirmation<br><sub>Methods: planning · theory · facts</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-08-23 · Multilingual · MIT</sub><br><sub>💡 Narration certainty must match the evidence ledger and direct quotes are verified one by one; the rest is a full production flow including batch image generation, local TTS/ASR and Three.js rendering</sub>

### General Story Methods

Story methods and principles not tied to one form: structure theory, character, dialogue, point of view, and de-AI techniques aimed at fiction.

#### Skills · prompts (28)

- 🌟 **[sepia](https://github.com/Nanako0129/sepia)** · ★ 3.2k<br>Three-pass revision based on AI-fiction structural features from the StoryScope paper: fixes narrative architecture (no stated theme, looser causality, delayed reveals), then paragraph flow and wording<br><sub>Methods: theory · revision · de-AI</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-15 · English · 6 skills · MIT</sub>

- 🌟 **[creative-writing-skills](https://github.com/haowjy/creative-writing-skills)** · ★ 513<br>A muse main agent dispatches sub-agents for brainstorming, character simulation, outline, writer, critic, editor and reader simulation, distills a style file from existing text, critiques, revises and syncs the knowledge base after writing<br><sub>Methods: memory · multi-agent · simulation · revision · style</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-15 · English · 24 skills · Apache-2.0</sub>

- **[agent-skills](https://github.com/jwynia/agent-skills)** · ★ 172<br>Large narrative skill collection: story coach, co-writing, outlining, character arcs, dialogue, endings, anti-cliché, flash fiction, and many worldbuilding systems<br><sub>Methods: planning · theory · worldbuilding · character</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-02-24 💤 · English · 119 skills</sub><br><sub>💡 Also contains nonfiction skills such as marketing; pick what you install</sub>

<a id="by-method"></a>
## By method

What each method solves, how projects implement it and where it goes wrong: see the [method guide](METHODS.en.md). Each method there is followed by every project that uses it:

- [Plan first: hierarchical outlines, decomposed drafting](METHODS.en.md#method-planning) (482)
- [Narrative theory: structure models, genre tropes, craft principles](METHODS.en.md#method-theory) (206)
- [Setting · worldbuilding](METHODS.en.md#method-worldbuilding) (148)
- [Character design · character profiles](METHODS.en.md#method-character) (189)
- [Long-form memory · continuity: state stores, setting bibles, retrieval](METHODS.en.md#method-memory) (452)
- [Multi-agent roles: writer, editor, reviewer, reader](METHODS.en.md#method-multiagent) (151)
- [Character and world simulation: let characters act out the plot](METHODS.en.md#method-simulation) (74)
- [Review · self-critique · iterative revision](METHODS.en.md#method-revision) (394)
- [Style learning · imitation: exemplars, style distillation, book teardowns](METHODS.en.md#method-style) (144)
- [De-AI · prose polishing](METHODS.en.md#method-deai) (94)
- [Interactive co-creation: reader choices, human-AI collaboration](METHODS.en.md#method-interactive) (199)
- [Fact constraints: source-driven, evidence checks, no fabrication](METHODS.en.md#method-factual) (52)

<a id="resources"></a>
## Resources

- [yingpengma/Awesome-Story-Generation](https://github.com/yingpengma/Awesome-Story-Generation), [Picrew/awesome-llm-story-generation](https://github.com/Picrew/awesome-llm-story-generation): paper lists on story generation, for research without released code
- Evaluation: [lechmazur/writing](https://github.com/lechmazur/writing) (short stories that must include 10 required elements, compared across models), [EQ-bench/creative-writing-bench](https://github.com/EQ-bench/creative-writing-bench) (creative writing benchmark), [jenna-russell/storyscope](https://github.com/jenna-russell/storyscope) (measures narrative-structure traits of AI fiction; [sepia](https://github.com/Nanako0129/sepia)'s de-AI method builds on it)
- [CHATS-lab/verbalized-sampling](https://github.com/CHATS-lab/verbalized-sampling): asks the model for several candidates with probabilities to reduce sameness; not fiction-specific, but often used for story ideas and openings
- [awesome-novel-skills](https://github.com/UnderleveledBuilder/awesome-novel-skills/blob/main/README.en.md): toolbox for web-novel writers, including downloaders, book sources, translation and publishing
- [awesome-short-drama-skills](https://github.com/UnderleveledBuilder/awesome-short-drama-skills/blob/main/README.en.md): AI short-drama and manju skills, including storyboards and video prompts
- [anthropics/skills](https://github.com/anthropics/skills): the official Agent Skills repo, a good starting point for writing your own skill

## Contributing

Suggest a project by [opening an issue](../../issues/new?template=submit-skill.yml), or edit `data/skills.toml` and open a PR; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) (in Chinese; English issues and PRs are welcome). Your own project is welcome too.
